implemented: Hurdle selection accepts development split observations only and enforces development dates before validation.
Predeclared candidate thresholds are evaluated by a 95% lower confidence bound of realized net alpha.
The frozen policy binds strategy, cohort, development data digest, protocol digest, validation date, selected hurdle, and freeze timestamp.
The hash-chained registry rejects policy changes; runner integration verifies policy identity and threshold and locks a strategy/cohort journal against dynamic edits.
